description: Return one site's details: live URL, status, plan, served file paths, whether editable source is stored (and its build settings), custom domains, bandwidth and the last 10 deploys. Use get_site to inspect a site before editing it; use list_sites to find site names, and get_app_status for container services.

name.description: Site name as shown by list_sites, e.g. my-portfolio. Provide name or siteId.

siteId.description: Site id from list_sites or get_site. Use instead of name.

name: get_site

usedMb.description: Outbound MB served by this site over the window (usage only; the bandwidth cap is team-scoped, see get_account).

windowDays.description: Length of the rolling usage window in days.

allowance.description: Custom domains the team's current plan includes.

connected.description: Custom domains on this site from both sources, one entry per hostname.

source.description: dashboard: linked on the dashboard Web Addresses page. mcp: added with add_custom_domain or the site API.

status.description: live: verified and serving this site. pending: linked, not verified yet.

nextTool.description: Present when this site has no custom domain yet and the team has room for one.

used.description: Distinct custom domains in use across the team, both sources (same count as get_account).

customDomains.description: Custom domains of this site and the team's custom-domain allowance; null when they could not be read.

filePaths.description: Site-relative paths of every served file, to pick paths to read, patch or delete. Omitted when the pod cannot be inspected (e.g. not ready); `files` then falls back to the last deploy's fileCount.

files.description: Number of files the site serves now (live count). After a patch deploy it can exceed the last deploy's fileCount.

source.description: How the deploy was triggered. Observed values: mcp, magic-file, git, quick-deploy, zip, ai-generate, staging, promote, rollback, manual-snapshot. New sources can be added by other code paths, so treat this as a hint, not a closed enum.

sourceManifest.description: Saved source build settings. Preserve these when rebuilding.

sourceStored.description: Whether editable source is stored. Read and edit source, then build_and_deploy when true.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Sites are usable only in 'active'. 'deleted' is the soft-delete recovery bucket (returned until the team's restore window expires and the sweeper purges the row). 'deleting' is the transient state of an in-flight hard-delete request.

title: Get site details
